title: 第17章 妖第18章 虎伥
content_zh:
夜色中。
那屋中男人的咳嗽声，愈发强烈。
陆生越听越觉得有些不对。
他不是没听过人咳嗽。
但那屋中男人的咳嗽声，明显不太对！
怎么说呢？
那不像是人类的咳嗽声，倒像是某些野兽低沉的嘶吼声！
陆生摇了摇头。
自己莫非是前世西游记看多了，变得有些疑神疑鬼了？
眼前这位大娘，分明就是人类。
若那屋中真是一只野兽或者妖精。
那这大娘多半早就没了性命！
陆生看向一旁的兄长。
孙悟空东看看西瞧瞧，一副好奇猴的模样。
见到自己兄长的反应。
陆生也放下心来。
以自己兄长的资质，若是真有妖精，应该瞒不过他！
院内。
大娘转过身，依旧低着头，轻声道：
“家里还空着两间房。”

“你们两个可以住一起，也可以分开住。”
听到大娘的话。
陆生点头：
“多谢大娘了！”
“我和兄长住一起便行！”
大娘没有多说，只是“嗯”
了一声。
随后。
大娘将两人带到一间房门前。
“你们先进去休息吧。”
“我去给你们拿两床被子。”
听到大娘的话。
一旁的孙悟空摆手道：
“不劳烦大娘！”
“俺和老二，从小便以地为床，以天为被。”
“只需一张床即可，不需要被子！”
听到孙悟空的话。
大娘不再多说：
“那你们两个便早点休息吧！”
说完。
content_en:
In the night.
The coughing sound of the man in the room became more intense.
The more Lu Sheng listened, the more he felt something was wrong.
It's not like he's never heard someone cough.
But the coughing sound of the man in the room was obviously not right!
How to say it?
It didn't sound like a human cough, but rather like the low roar of some wild beast!
Lu Sheng shook his head.
Could it be that I read too much Journey to the West in my previous life and became a little suspicious?
The lady in front of me is clearly human.
If there was really a beast or goblin in the house.
Then this lady would probably have died a long time ago!
Lu Sheng looked at his brother beside him.
Sun Wukong looked here and there, looking like a curious monkey.
Seeing his brother's reaction.
Lu Sheng was also relieved.
With his brother's qualifications, if there really is a goblin, he shouldn't be able to hide it from him!
In the courtyard.
The aunt turned around, still lowering her head, and said softly:
"There are still two empty rooms in the house."
"You two can live together or separately."
I heard what my aunt said.
Lu Sheng nodded:
"Thank you so much, ma'am!"
"My brother and I can live together!"
The aunt didn't say much, just "Yeah"
There was a sound.
Subsequently.
The aunt brought the two people to the door of a room.
"You guys go in and rest first."
"I'll get you two quilts."
I heard what my aunt said.
Sun Wukong on the side waved his hand and said:
"Don't bother me, ma'am!"
"My second child and I have used the earth as our bed and the sky as our quilt since we were children."
“Just a bed, no quilt required!”
Hear what Sun Wukong said.
Auntie said no more:
"Then you two should rest early!"
Finished.
